topic: Ada Blackjack, the seamstress who was the sole survivor of the 1921 Wrangel Island Arctic expedition
title: She Was Hired to Sew. She Outlived Every Man on the Expedition.
description: The true, sourced story of Ada Blackjack -- the Inupiat seamstress hired for an ill-fated 1921 Arctic expedition to claim Wrangel Island, and the only member of her four-person team who survived. AI-narrated original commentary, not a repost.

hook_candidates.text: Here's the seamstress who outlived every man on that expedition, alone, with only a cat.
What happens when the three men who go for help across the ice never come back?
Arctic expeditions weren't won by the toughest survivalist on the team. This one was won by the seamstress nobody trained to hunt.
In 1921, four men and one seamstress sailed to claim an island for the British Empire. Only she made it home.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend obsessed with reality TV survival shows, because they want to show them what real survival actually looked like.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume the survivor of a deadly Arctic expedition would be a trained explorer, not the seamstress who outlived every man alone.
closing_comment: Ada Blackjack and her cat Vic both survived this Arctic expedition on Wrangel Island, which deserves its own documentary.

sources.note: Confirms Ada Blackjack was hired as seamstress with no survival training and was the expedition's sole survivor.
Confirms the three men who left for Siberia in Jan 1923 were never found; Lorne Knight died of scurvy June 23, 1923.
Confirms Soviet icebreaker Red October seized Wrangel Island Aug 1924, arresting American settlers there.
